Package org.jdesktop.lg3d.apps.orgchart.ui.agenda

Class InvitationBuilder

java.lang.Object
org.jdesktop.lg3d.apps.orgchart.ui.agenda.InvitationBuilder
public final class InvitationBuilder extends Object
Builds a real RFC 5545 iCalendar meeting request for an Appointment: the text/calendar payload with METHOD:REQUEST (so the recipient's mail client offers accept / tentative / decline), the human-readable invitation draft around it, and the invite.ics attachment that carries the payload.

The class is deliberately pure and AWT-free — every method is a static function of its arguments (the "now" instants are passed in) — so the whole wire format is unit-testable headlessly. Sending is InvitationSender's job; this class only composes.

Times are emitted as UTC (...Z) from the desktop's local zone: an appointment's concrete date is the displayed week's date for its day-of-week, its start hour is on the hour, and its duration is whole hours, so the conversion is exact and unambiguous on the wire.

    • buildICalendar

      public static String buildICalendar(Appointment a, LocalDate date, ZoneId zone, Instant dtstamp, MailAccount organizer, List<ContactDirectory.ContactInfo> invitees)
      Renders the full VCALENDAR object: a single VEVENT with METHOD:REQUEST, the organizer and one RSVP=TRUE attendee line per invitee, folded to RFC 5545 line length and terminated with CRLF line breaks.
      Parameters:
      a - the appointment to invite to
      date - the concrete calendar date of the occurrence
      zone - the desktop's local zone the hours are read in
      dtstamp - the "sent at" instant (passed in so tests are exact)
      organizer - the sending mail account (the event's organizer)
      invitees - the resolved contacts to invite (blank e-mails ignored)
      Returns:
      the iCalendar payload as text
